# Routes without auth

List every route whose middleware has no `auth` entry.

<!-- generated:recipe:routes-without-auth -->
<!-- Generated by `just docs-generate`; edit the source, not this block. -->

```php
use Lucasp\Loom\Index\IndexLoader;

$index = (new IndexLoader)->fromFile('storage/loom/index.json');

foreach ($index->routes() as $route) {
    $guarded = collect($route->middleware)->contains(fn (string $name): bool => str_starts_with($name, 'auth'));

    if (! $guarded) {
        echo "{$route->method} {$route->uri}  {$route->file}:{$route->line}\n";
    }
}
```

```text title="Output"
GET /health  routes/web.php:8
```
<!-- /generated:recipe:routes-without-auth -->

Middleware names are recorded as written, with groups such as `web` not expanded ([`routes[]`](../reference/schema.md#routes)), so a group that adds `auth` elsewhere is not seen here.
